rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card and dated predictions before data; synthetic validation on the real #51 skeleton (8 worlds x 3 units x 3 reps) forcing a dated pre-data amendment (drive-robust estimators for both rates, pooled kill rules); replication on 12 units x 3 vector variants (both embedding models); 3 natives (1 mixed, 1 failed, 1 inconclusive); 112 estimates rows; confirm.py frozen with hashes, guarded, dry-run. Missing: holdout run, 1-call kick kernel, transfer to shared-goal weeks.
rationale.faithfulness: The one-rate OU model fails by an order of magnitude (rho_gamma ~15, 90% CI [7, 30], all variants): the read kick is real and read-gated (J_K beats the in-flight placebo in every unit >= 3 days) but decays in ~7 calls while the well relaxes in ~100 calls, homogeneous across units and robust to context erasure. Joiners do not relax at gamma. Scorecard A1 B1 C2 D1 E1 F2 G0 H1 I0.
rationale.usefulness: Two measured time scales for an operator: a message's effect lasts ~5 min (7 calls); an agent's own line lasts ~1 h and survives erasure. Repeat inputs to steer; single messages echo and fade.
